question: For customers who made transactions at gas stations in the Czech Republic with a unit price (Price / Amount) greater than 10.0 for any product, what was their average consumption decrease rate from 2012 to 2013?

WITH qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.XCL_013 AS customer_id
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
    INNER JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.XCL_015 = g.XCL_004
    INNER JOIN products AS p ON t.XCL_016 = p.XCL_008
    WHERE g.XCL_006 = 'CZE'
      AND t.XCL_017 > 0
      AND (t.XCL_018 * 1.0 / t.XCL_017) > 10.0
),
consumption_data AS (
    SELECT 
        q.customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM qualifying_customers AS q
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS y ON q.customer_id = y.XCL_019
    WHERE SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY q.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG((consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) * 1.0 / consumption_2012) AS avg_decrease_rate
FROM consumption_data
WHERE consumption_2012 > 0

WITH qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.XCL_013 AS customer_id
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
    INNER JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.XCL_015 = g.XCL_004
    INNER JOIN products AS p ON t.XCL_016 = p.XCL_008
    WHERE g.XCL_006 = 'CZE'
      AND t.XCL_017 > 0
      AND (t.XCL_018 * 1.0 / t.XCL_017) > 10.0
),
consumption_data AS (
    SELECT 
        q.customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM qualifying_customers AS q
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS y ON q.customer_id = y.XCL_019
    WHERE SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY q.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG((consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) * 1.0 / consumption_2012) AS avg_decrease_rate
FROM consumption_data
WHERE consumption_2012 > 0

WITH qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.XCL_013 AS customer_id
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
    INNER JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.XCL_015 = g.XCL_004
    INNER JOIN products AS p ON t.XCL_016 = p.XCL_008
    WHERE g.XCL_006 = 'CZE'
      AND t.XCL_017 > 0
      AND (t.XCL_018 * 1.0 / t.XCL_017) > 10.0
),
consumption_data AS (
    SELECT 
        q.customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM qualifying_customers AS q
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS y ON q.customer_id = y.XCL_019
    WHERE SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY q.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG((consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) * 1.0 / consumption_2012) AS avg_decrease_rate
FROM consumption_data
WHERE consumption_2012 > 0

    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_001 AS customer_id
    FROM customers c
    JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    JOIN gasstations g ON t.XCL_015 = g.XCL_004
    JOIN products p ON t.XCL_016 = p.XCL_008
    WHERE g.XCL_006 = 'CZE'
      AND t.XCL_017 > 0
      AND (t.XCL_018 * 1.0 / t.XCL_017) > 10.0
),
consumption_data AS (
    SELECT 
        q.customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM qualifying_customers q
    JOIN yearmonth y ON q.customer_id = y.XCL_019
    WHERE SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY q.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG((consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) * 1.0 / consumption_2012) AS avg_decrease_rate
FROM consumption_data
WHERE consumption_2012 > 0;
